description: This source file contains a PHPUnit test class called SanitizerTest that tests the functionality of the Sanitizer utility class for sanitizing SVG images to prevent security vulnerabilities such as cross-site scripting. The test class includes multiple test cases for different SVG inputs, verifying that malicious scripts or attributes are properly sanitized or removed.

classes.name: SanitizerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'sanitizeSvg' function of the Sanitizer class, ensuring security and correctness in sanitizing SVG images against scripting vulnerabilities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating instances of Sanitizer and DOMDocument before each test.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithScriptTag
methods.description: Verifies that SVG containing a script tag is sanitized by removing the script element.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithOnClick
methods.description: Ensures that SVG with an inline 'onclick' attribute is sanitized by removing or neutralizing the attribute.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithAnimate
methods.description: Checks that SVG with an 'animate' tag containing scripting code is sanitized by removing the animate element.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithRegularSVG
methods.description: Confirms that a well-formed, safe SVG remains unaltered after sanitation.

methods.name: testSanitizeSVGWithBadlyFormattedSVG
methods.description: Validates that a malformed SVG triggers a SanitizerException with the message 'SVG is badly formatted.'
